t.rel: It disputed the Bakassi Peninsula with Nigeria until an international ruling settled it. It faces Boko Haram in the north and a separatist conflict in its English-speaking west.
t.know: Both French and English are official languages.
t.etext: It sells oil, cocoa, coffee, timber and bananas, and shares a currency with other Central African countries. The conflict in its English-speaking regions and armed groups in the north weigh on the economy.
